text: This report recommends the reduction of the speed limit from 70 km/h to 60 km/h on Kingston Road between Graham Farm Lane and a point 707 metres northeast of Graham Farm Lane (at the City Limit with the City of Pickering in Durham Region). Currently, the speed limit is 70 km/h but is posted at 60 km/h, while the speed limit west of Graham Farm Land and east in Pickering is 60 km/h.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council reduce the speed limit from 70 kilometres an hour to 60 kilometres an hour on Kingston Road, between Graham Farm Lane and a point 707 metres northeast of Graham Farm Lane.
